property_summary: For any address that has never locked a guess, calling settle must revert because the require(block.number > guesses[msg.sender].block) check fails (stored block is 0); the mutant replaces the guard on guesses[msg.sender].block != 0 with require(true), so settle proceeds and clears/settles a zero-answer guess without reverting.
change_summary: Replace the guess-block precondition with a tautology so settle can proceed when no guess block has been recorded.
